item.title: Ilia Malinin postpones press conference a day after eighth-place Olympic finish
item.description: USA Olympic figure skater Ilia Malinin finished eighth after falling twice during his performance, shocking fans who expected the American star to win gold.

item.title: US hockey team storms back from early deficit to crush Denmark in dominant performance
item.description: Team USA rallied from a 2-1 deficit to beat Denmark at the Milan Cortina Olympics, firing 47 shots and getting goals from six different players to stay in the hunt for gold.

item.title: Global protests call for Iran regime change in major cities worldwide after bloody crackdown
item.description: Over 250,000 anti-Iran regime protesters rally in Munich as Global Day of Action demonstrations span major cities worldwide calling for leadership change.

item.title: Canada's curling team accuses Sweden of filming violation in response to Olympic cheating allegations
item.description: Canada's curling team fires back at Sweden after the Swedes accused Canadians of cheating at the Winter Olympics. Marc Kennedy alleged Sweden planned to catch teams breaking rules.

item.title: Rubio meets with Zelenskyy ahead of crucial Geneva talks, says Trump wants solution that 'ends bloodshed'
item.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy met with U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio in Munich Saturday. He also said he spoke with Trump envoy Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner.

item.title: Olympic hockey fans raise Greenland's flag during USA's dominant win over Denmark, sparking viral reaction
item.description: European fans waved Greenland's flag during Team USA's 6-3 win over Denmark in Olympic hockey amid President Donald Trump's acquisition plans.

item.title: Hillary Clinton says migration 'went too far' and 'needs to be fixed in a humane way'
item.description: Hillary Clinton appears to shift stance on immigration, calling migration "disruptive" and advocating for secure borders at Munich Security Conference.

item.title: Prince William, Kate Middleton prioritize family over duty as shown by handling of cancer diagnosis: author
item.description: Prince William and Kate Middleton prioritize family over royal duties, a royal author said, pointing to how the couple handled her cancer treatment as an example.
